The VSOL V3600D8 8-Port 10G EPON OLT is a powerful and scalable fiber access solution designed for ISPs, FTTH/FTTB networks, and enterprise broadband deployments. Supporting a 1:256 split ratio per PON port, this compact 1U rack-mount EPON OLT delivers high bandwidth, stability, and flexibility for modern fiber networks.


With 8× 10G EPON ports, advanced uplink options, and carrier-grade performance, the VSOL V3600D8 ensures reliable high-speed data transmission while reducing network expansion costs. It is fully compatible with EPON ONUs and ideal for next-generation broadband and 5G backhaul applications.

Key Features


  • 8 × 10G EPON PON Ports
  • Supports 1:256 Split Ratio per PON port
  • High-capacity 880Gbps switching fabric
  • Multiple uplink options (GE / 10GE / 25GE / 40GE / 100GE)
  • Compact 1U 19-inch rack-mount design
  • Supports FTTH, FTTB, FTTC, and ISP networks
  • Carrier-grade reliability and performance
  • Easy management via Web, CLI, SNMP
